title: Standalone lichend cannot provision any runtime GCP OSCORE peer
description: lichend loads durable TrustStore/GatewayCoordinator and calls Gateway runtime GCP ingress, but no daemon config or enrollment path invokes admit_gateway/install_gcp_context. SecureStack therefore has no context and every standalone GCP packet fails before dispatch. Extend existing TOML config with a spec GCP-3 closed-PSK federation mode and explicit peer public keys, durably provision/bind those configured trust anchors, derive collision-checked bounded OSCORE contexts, install them before entering radio loops, fail closed on invalid/ambiguous configuration, and add configuration/startup-runtime integration coverage. Open mode must remain explicit rather than silently unauthenticated.
